status: official-source research complete; concept only, no production integrations
recommendation: Ship an editorial, completion-aware feed and real data foundations before optional focus shielding. Preserve the full product; remove repetition, not capability.

decisions.title: Focus, not a trap
decisions.summary: User-chosen selected-app protection with a time limit and immediate bypass. Never promise the entire phone is locked until exercise.
details: iOS individual Family Controls authorization, ManagedSettings shields and DeviceActivity require native work plus distribution entitlement approval.
Android consumer blocking is not equivalent to managed-device kiosk control; accessibility approaches need clear disclosure, consent and Play policy review.
Missing, delayed or denied activity data must never trap the user. Essential access and rest/accessibility alternatives remain available.
decisions.dataSource: NEW native Screen Time / policy-compliant Android bridge and restriction-session model; not present in the repo.

decisions.title: Real movement first
decisions.summary: Steps and workout progress require real ingestion and provenance; today’s app shows fixtures.
details: HealthKit stepCount/workouts on iOS; aggregated Health Connect steps/exercise on supported Android devices.
An available phone sensor / Expo Pedometer is a foreground feedback fallback, not cross-device daily history.
Background delivery is not immediate or guaranteed. Do not promise instant exercise-triggered unblocking.
Deduplicate sources, respect timezone/day boundaries, show permissions, freshness and no-data states.
decisions.dataSource: Existing health_sample source/device/confidence, daily_health.steps and habit_log.source; real ingestion still missing.

decisions.title: Evidence without pretending
decisions.summary: Distinguish self-report, recorded activity and estimated exercise. Steps do not prove a run or push-ups.
details: A workout record can be manually entered or inaccurate; show its source rather than an absolute ‘verified’ badge.
Photos and voice are submissions, not objective proof. Camera rep estimation is separate research and consented processing.
Keep exercise footage and health evaluation on-device when possible; never upload by default.
decisions.dataSource: Existing habit/habit_log plus NEW evidence/observation metadata and consent; no verification service currently exists.

decisions.title: Swipe to choose
decisions.summary: A short, bounded deck for choosing a daily move; ordinary labelled buttons remain available.
details: Right chooses a move for today; left defers that candidate. Both have Undo.
Neither action completes a task, submits a form, awards progress or changes Aim value.
Deadlines remain visible outside the deck; no endless feed or punitive streak mechanic.
decisions.dataSource: Existing engine task candidates, plan_day.moves, mission refs and nudge outcomes; selection must not mutate completion.

decisions.title: A day that genuinely changes
decisions.summary: Check-in and completed actions give space back instead of stacking more cards.
details: Determine today’s Pulse by local day, not whether any historic Pulse exists.
Retain level, Aim, editorial prose, five Body readings, life knows you, life is asking and due dates.
Unify selection, actual task status, outcomes and date sources before claiming adaptive intelligence.
decisions.dataSource: Existing pulseLog / pulse_log, local-day identity, plan_day, mission_step and recorded outcomes.

roadmap.title: One truthful daily loop
roadmap.source: pulseLog, plan_day, mission_step, recorded outcomes, confirmed date fields
roadmap.body: Local-day check-in, consistent task status, sourced countdowns and explicit completion. No synthetic knowledge-confidence claims.

roadmap.title: Accounts, sync and service boundaries
roadmap.source: Existing SQLite/outbox and local API; Better Auth + Neon/RLS + production file/model adapters still to connect
roadmap.body: Keep local data safe through sign-in, recovery and offline sync. Live AI must use authenticated, consented minimum context.

roadmap.title: Real steps and health provenance
roadmap.source: HealthKit/Health Connect, supported sensor fallback, health_sample, daily_health
roadmap.body: Permissions, source arbitration, freshness and no-data states before any automatic habit completion. Validate wellness scores separately.

roadmap.title: Make intake and answers genuinely useful
roadmap.source: Existing record/document/food_entry shapes and native OCR source; live vision/extraction, nutrition lookup, Fenny lesson/analysis and evaluated voice/model providers still to wire
roadmap.body: A picked file or meal needs a real reader, reviewable result, confirmation, correct destination and an updated plan. Keep camera/health uploads consented and model limitations visible.

roadmap.title: Durable follow-through
roadmap.source: habit_log, background-task capability, calendar consent, notifications, learning_record / FSRS
roadmap.body: Real reminders with quiet hours, recall scheduling and focus-session timing. Finishing a timer is not proof of completing the work.

roadmap.title: Optional selection and focus experiments
roadmap.source: Proposed bounded move picker; NEW restriction/evidence models and native entitlements
roadmap.body: Test whether these reduce friction. Selected-app shielding and camera estimation are optional, policy-dependent work—not prerequisites for core usefulness.
